title: Do Coding Agents Still Need a Debugger? Frontier-Model-Based Fault Localization at the Accuracy Ceiling
title_zh: 编码智能体还需要调试器吗？达到准确率天花板的前沿模型故障定位

paragraphs.en: 实验表明前沿编码智能体仅凭源代码即可定位几乎所有故障，调试器辅助收益有限且 token 代价极高。 Background: To localize a fault, a coding agent can reason from source code alone or use debugger assistance by running the program and stepping through it in an interactive debugger. While earlier agents struggled with static execution tracing and debugger operation, frontier LLMs have improved at both. Objective: We evaluate how accurately coding agents localize faults without tools across original and transformed programs, how much debugger assistance improves accuracy and at what cost, and how agents use it when optional. Methods: We seed 610 single-line faults into 144 LeetCodeDataset solutions and rewrite each faulty program with five recipes of behavior-preserving transformations. Agents based on Sol 6.1, Luna 6, and Qwen 3.8 localize each fault with no, optional, or encouraged debugger assistance. Results: Without tools, the agents localized 98.2 to 99.9% of faults in original and 96.7 to 99.9% in transformed programs, losing accuracy mainly where recipes restructured loops and conditions. Encouraged assistance removed 63% and 61% of Luna 6's and Qwen 3.8's remaining transformed errors (+2.1 and +1.3 percentage points) at 14.7 to 27.0 times the token use, while Sol 6.1 stayed at 99.9%. With optional assistance, Luna 6 and Qwen 3.8 still gained +1.5 and +1.3 points, though the agents used the interactive debugger in only 0.2 to 6.2% of runs. Conclusions: On short, precisely specified programs, current coding agents localize nearly all faults from source code alone, and debugger assistance removes most errors that remain. Given the choice, agents executed the program far more often than they stepped through it, yet kept most of the benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，前沿编码智能体仅凭源代码即可定位几乎所有故障，调试器辅助收益有限且 token 代价极高。背景：为了定位故障，编码智能体可以仅凭源代码进行推理，也可以借助调试器辅助，通过运行程序并在交互式调试器中逐步执行来定位故障。 虽然早期的智能体在静态执行追踪和调试器操作上表现不佳，但前沿大语言模型在这两方面都有所改进。 目标：我们评估编码智能体在无工具情况下对原始程序和变换后程序的故障定位准确度，调试器辅助能提升多少准确度以及代价如何，以及在调试器可选时智能体如何使用它。 方法：我们向 144 个 LeetCodeDataset 解答注入 610 个单行故障，并使用五种保持行为不变的变换规则对每个故障程序进行重写。 基于 Sol 6.1、Luna 6 和 Qwen 3.8 的智能体分别在无调试器辅助、可选调试器辅助和鼓励使用调试器辅助的条件下定位每个故障。 结果：在无工具情况下，智能体对原始程序中故障的定位率为 98.2% 到 99.9%，对变换后程序中故障的定位率为 96.7% 到 99.9%，准确度的损失主要出现在变换规则重构了循环和条件的地方。 在 token 使用量增至 14.7 到 27.0 倍的情况下，鼓励使用调试器辅助消除了 Luna 6 和 Qwen 3.8 在变换后程序中剩余错误的 63% 和 61%（分别提升 2.1 和 1.3 个百分点），而 Sol 6.1 则保持在 99.9%。 在调试器可选的情况下，Luna 6 和 Qwen 3.8 仍分别提升 1.5 和 1.3 个百分点，不过智能体仅在 0.2% 到 6.2% 的运行中使用了交互式调试器。 结论：在简短且明确规定的程序上，当前的编码智能体仅凭源代码即可定位几乎所有故障，调试器辅助能消除其中剩余的大多数错误。 在可以选择的情况下，智能体运行程序的频率远高于逐步执行程序，但仍保留了大部分收益。
